factory_mission.scope: Surveyed high-level waypoint mission; no local path or obstacle truth is supplied to DiT. Centerline clearance is not a learned-path collision certificate.

initialization_scope: Start pose authored before Newton initialization; no runtime robot pose writes

lidar.scan_pattern: non-repeating low-discrepancy solid-angle coverage; not Livox firing sequence
lidar.scan_timing: instantaneous snapshot; all hit timestamps equal simulation capture time
limitations: no rolling-scan motion distortion or IMU
collision geometry only; visual-only, particle and deformable obstacles unsupported

collision.scope: Robot versus environment only; self contacts excluded; evaluator-only truth

sensing_schedule: every 0.1 simulation seconds or 0.1 wall seconds, whichever comes first; timestamped actual physics state

loop_profile.scope: Host wall phases, including CUDA waits; no extra synchronization. Worker runs concurrently.
loop_profile.caveat: Physics launch and later readback waits can fall in different phases; not pure solver kernel time.

mapper.unknown_policy: zero-valued distance with separate explicit known flags; never certified free
mapper.history: four cumulative causal snapshots, nominal 0.2 s apart; actual ages retained under bounded asynchronous jitter, common planning-anchor coordinates

checkpoint.factory_map_policy: World-aligned static measured map, retained for <=120 s and sensor displacement <=28 m; reanchor resets local four-snapshot history. No obstacle truth integration.
checkpoint.input_scope: measured historical scans, measured start pose and requested goal; no obstacle truth

mission.scope: Surveyed high-level waypoint mission; no local path or obstacle truth is supplied to DiT. Centerline clearance is not a learned-path collision certificate.
